## Video quality

Generated subjects could appear as streaks or unrecognizable fragments. Video now uses a larger frame from the start and 20 sampling steps. The frame menu shows the generated dimensions. Landscape is 1280 × 704, portrait is 704 × 1280, and square is 960 × 960.

On a 12 GB RTX 3060, we repeated the previous two-second sailboat test with the same prompt, seed (3115439229), model, duration and encoder. The hull and sail remained recognizable in opening, middle and ending frames. Worker time increased from 36.9 seconds to 210.5 seconds. A four-second square desktop generation at a fresh seed took 472.6 seconds. We tested playback and verified the exported MP4 against the render hash. Four composer and request recovery checks passed.
